title: RACES vs. ARES
idea: RACES is an FCC service for civil defense and needs civil defense certification. ARES is a volunteer group. FCC rules apply to both.

rows: An FCC Part 97 service for civil defense communications in national emergencies
Licensed hams who voluntarily register their qualifications and equipment for public service
Certification of enrollment by a civil defense organization

cards.t: An FCC Part 97 service for civil defense communications
cards.why: RACES is the Radio Amateur Civil Emergency Service.

cards.t: Needs certification by a civil defense agency
cards.why: RACES control operators need certification of enrollment by a civil defense organization.

cards.t: Hams who voluntarily register their skills and equipment for public service
cards.why: That's the Amateur Radio Emergency Service.

compare.how: Civil defense. Needs civil defense certification.

traps.wrong: Membership in the Amateur Radio Emergency Service (ARES)
traps.why: RACES needs certification of enrollment by a civil defense organization, not ARES membership.
FCC rules always apply, RACES included.
ARES is volunteer registration. RACES is the one that needs civil defense certification.

traps.wrong: An emergency organization combining amateur radio and citizens band operators and frequencies
traps.why: RACES is an amateur service under Part 97, for civil defense. No CB.

traps.wrong: A training program that certifies amateur operators for membership in the Radio Amateur Civil Emergency Service
traps.why: ARES is a group of volunteers who register their qualifications and equipment, not a training program.
